text.desc:
Radius of the area in which the invisible cursor in the center of the wheel moves. 
The smaller the value, the more responsive the wheel is.
text.name: Cursor Radius Per Entry

text.desc:
If you hold onto the toggle key longer than this time(seconds), 
wheel automatically closes once you release the key.
text.name: Toggle Hold Threshold (seconds)

text.desc: When ON, Wheeler disables gameplay controls while edit mode is active in Inventory/Magic/Favorites. Turn OFF to keep v1.3-like behavior and avoid ControlMap blocking.
text.name: Block Game Input In Edit Mode

text.desc: When ON, Inventory/Magic/Favorites menus are hidden while Wheeler edit mode is active. Turn OFF to keep those menus visible behind Wheeler.
text.name: Hide Game UI In Edit Mode

text.desc: Let the wheel's toggle button keep its normal game function: the same press that opens or closes the wheel is also handed to the game, so a D-pad direction or a key bound in the game's controls still does what it always did. A toggle that uses a modifier is not affected. On by default. A D-pad direction with 'D-Pad Toggle: Hold To Open' on is not shared: it is decided by duration instead.
text.name: Toggle Key Keeps Its Game Function

text.desc: When the gamepad toggle is a D-pad direction with no modifier, HOLD it to open the wheel and TAP it to use the D-pad normally - the tap goes to the game or to the open menu as if Wheeler were not there. The hold length is Toggle Hold Threshold. Other buttons keep press-to-toggle. On by default.
text.name: D-Pad Toggle: Hold To Open, Tap For The Game

text.desc:
Press this key to open/close wheel.
If you hold this key for longer than "Toggle Hold Threshold" time,
releasing the key closes the wheel.
text.name: Toggle Wheel

text.desc: Show or hide the edit-mode hint panel while Wheeler edit mode is active. Set to 0 to disable this shortcut entirely.
text.name: Toggle Edit Hints

text.desc: Closes the wheel immediately. Set to 0 to disable this shortcut entirely.
text.name: Exit Wheel

text.desc: Alternative immediate close shortcut. Set to 0 to disable this shortcut entirely.
text.name: Exit Wheel Alt

text.desc: Optional modifier for chord input. Hold modifier + this key/button to trigger the action (for example RB+X or Shift+Q). Leave unbound (0) to keep current behavior. When a Toggle Modifier is set, the base key can be reused for other Wheeler bindings.
text.name: Toggle Wheel Modifier (optional)

text.desc: Go to the next wheel in the set of available wheels.
text.name: Next Wheel

text.desc: Go to the previous wheel in the set of available wheels.
text.name: Previous Wheel

text.desc: Switch to the next item in the current highlighted slot.
text.name: Next Item

text.desc: Switch to the previous item in the current highlighted slot.
text.name: Previous Item

text.desc:
Adds: in edit mode this puts the highlighted item into the slot.

Outside edit mode it activates the item, which usually equips it to your right hand.
text.name: Add
Remove

text.desc:
Add an empty wheel to the set of wheels.
This button is only functional under edit mode(i.e. when you're inside inventory or magic menu).
text.name: Add Wheel

text.desc:
Add an empty entry to the current wheel.
This button is only functional under edit mode(i.e. when you're inside inventory or magic menu).

text.desc:
Move the currently highlighted entry one slot forward.
This button is only functional under edit mode(i.e. when you're inside inventory or magic menu).
text.name: Move Entry Forward

text.desc:
Move the currently highlighted entry one slot back.
This button is only functional under edit mode(i.e. when you're inside inventory or magic menu).
text.name: Move Entry Back

text.desc: Pick the highlighted slot up with everything in it; move to another slot and press again to drop it there - the slots between shift along. Press it on the slot in hand to put it back. Only in edit mode.
text.name: Pick Up / Drop Slot

text.desc:
Move the currently active wheel forward in the set of wheels.
This button is only functional under edit mode(i.e. when you're inside inventory or magic menu).
text.name: Move Wheel Forward

text.desc:
Move the currently active wheel back in the set of wheels.
This button is only functional under edit mode(i.e. when you're inside inventory or magic menu).
text.name: Move Wheel Back

text.desc: On: letting the stick come back to the middle puts the cursor at the wheel's centre, so no slot stays highlighted from a push you have finished. Off: the slot you last pushed towards stays highlighted until you push again.
text.name: Auto Center Rest Snap

text.desc: Turn the game's own Favorites menu off completely, so Wheeler takes its place. On by default (the owner, 2026-09-16): the wheel IS the favorites menu here, and a Favorites control still holding its buttons also stops the game giving those buttons to anything else.
text.name: Disable Vanilla Favorites Menu

text.desc: The Perfected Wheeler favorites system: two named wheels on install (Inventory Wheel, Magic Wheel), favorites going straight to the slot whose category takes them, shouts and powers locked in the Inventory Wheel's bottom slot, and the Magic menu opening on the Magic Wheel. On by default. Off, Wheeler behaves as it did before this system existed; the categories stay on the Wheel Behavior > Favorites Menu tab for when it is on.
text.name: Perfected Wheeler Favorites System

text.desc: While the wheel is open the left stick no longer moves your character; its four directions become controller buttons (Left Stick Up, Down, Left, Right) that any wheel action can be bound to on the Gamepad page. Move Wheel Forward ships on Left Stick Right and Move Wheel Back on Left Stick Left. Off, the stick moves your character as it always did.
text.name: Left stick controls the wheel

text.desc: Stop the game completely while the wheel is open, whatever the slow-time scale on the Styles page says. Off, the wheel slows time by that scale instead.
text.name: Stop time while the wheel is open

text.desc: On shows every section of this page. Off keeps only the first three - Wheeler Controls, Wheel Behavior and Ammo Wheel - and hides the rest until you turn it back on. On by default.
text.name: Advanced settings

text.desc: Resets all wheels to the default configuration(2 wheels + 4 entries), removing all items.
text.name: Reset All Wheels
